question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the word: **Amplify**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"Amplify"** means to increase the volume, intensity, or extent of something; it refers to making something more pronounced or stronger. (विस्तारित करना, बढ़ाना)

 

 
• **Example: **The teacher used a microphone to amplify her voice during the lecture.

 

 

 
• **"Reduce"** is the antonym of amplify, meaning to make something smaller or less in amount, degree, or intensity. (कम करना)

 

 
• **Example: **The company decided to reduce its expenses to improve profitability.

 

 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Amplify' **is **'Reduce'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expand **(विस्तारित करना): To make something larger or more extensive.

 

 
• **Example:** The company plans to expand its operations to new markets next year.

 

 

 
• **Magnify **(बड़ा करना): To enlarge something or make it appear larger, especially through a lens or microscope.

 

 
• **Example: **The scientist used a magnifying glass to study the tiny insect.

 

 

 
• **Increase** (बढ़ाना): To become greater in size, quantity, or degree.

 

 
• **Example:** The government aims to increase the budget for education next year.
